reason: Document A is addressed to me by name. It gives a specific case I can't dismiss: a resident missed two dialysis appointments. It also makes three concrete requests I could act on and offers the association's own help, an evening meeting and a list of residents who need help on the stairs, so it reads as a real group I can work with rather than a few loud people. Document B is full of placeholders, asks for open-ended explanations and offers nothing in return.
